newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Bank/Portugal injects 11.7 bln esc at end-period.
newsitem.headline: Bank/Portugal injects 11.7 bln esc at end-period.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal said it injected an extra 11.7 billion escudos into the money market at a rate fixed at 8.20 percent at the end of its accounting period for commercial bank cash reserves on Friday.

The injection facility is granted to banks after markets have closed on the final day of each period. The rate is fixed at one percentage point above the highest money market rate for funds of up to five days.
